scope: Durable continuation notes from completed internal read-only reviews. These are findings and remaining checks, not proof of release qualification.

delta_review.scanner_partitioning: Planning outputPartitioning must never force perPartitionData or execute scalar subqueries. Current UnknownPartitioning(0) is metadata-only: upstream core actual fused execution derives partition count from perPartitionData.length. Preserve that execution invariant and live runtimeFilters on sparkFallback.
delta_review.serialization: nativeOp and serializedPlanOpt are driver-only transient fields. JVM regression passed clone/copy retention and Java serialization omission. Query-text interning is J17/G08, not completed by these changes. Full J17 interning requires the related internScan/internCommons/internScans core APIs and the task-binary regression; transient fields alone do not complete that old contract.
delta_review.old_deadlock_reproducer: Original full Joom end-to-end reproducer depends on BoundaryFormats (G09). G01 adds direct scalar data-filter planning regression; preserve full reproduction for G09 rather than silently treating it as already covered.

s3_encryption_context.source: Selected production/unit portions of upstream draftPR7593, local original JSON ${MIGRATION_AUX_ROOT}/20261115_comet-upstream-branches-pr-audit/pr-7593-detail.json
s3_encryption_context.why: Hadoop3.5 validates context during S3A initialization; native reader does not. Local Delta logs may reference S3 data/DV without metadata initializing that bucket, so missing guard permits success where Spark must fail.
s3_encryption_context.required_behavior: After encryption-algorithm gate, inspect dataFileUris plus DV URIs. Reject nonempty/unverifiable Hadoop-effective context, preserve global/short/long aliases and credential-provider rules, redact values/paths. Pure GCS is unaffected.
s3_encryption_context.io: Conf-only with no provider; may read local global JCEKS. Reject nonlocal and S3A-specific providers without opening them. Do not describe helper as unconditionally zero-I/O.
s3_encryption_context.tests: Keep plan-only local-log/S3-DV real-claim test: cold metadata error test fails before Comet admission and is insufficient alone. Do not collect the synthetic remote-DV dataframe. Cold metadata test pins loopback endpoint127.0.0.1:1 and SimpleAWSCredentialsProvider.
s3_encryption_context.do_not_weaken: Do not simply trim final effective context: whitespace long alias plus malformed short alias could admit a scan that Hadoop rejects. Current conservative fallback is deliberate.
s3_encryption_context.gcp_control: PASSED in repeated full291 Delta tests

delta_review.actual_gcp_validation: Real GCS/GKE ADC reading has not been tested. Local auth-whitelist/unit tests are not that qualification.

partitioning_followup.recommendation: Retain Unknown0. Direct upstream core contract and Spark4.2.1 nonbucketed scan behavior justify it; extending only filter guards still violates no-planning perPartitionData contract.
partitioning_followup.difference: Unknown1 satisfies AllTuples, Unknown0 does not; possible extra SinglePartition exchange relative to oldcontrib, not measured. Same as sourceJoom and standardSpark. No new product approval needed.

vendor_review.pristine_import: Published archive55.2.0, not a Git workspace-inheriting manifest. Separate commit98c9f2f19 preserves150 archive files. No .cargo_vcs_info.json in this archive; do not claim it exists.
vendor_review.resolution: Use root native/Cargo.lock and root crates-io patch. Vendor nested Cargo.lock remains pristine provenance only; native workspace_root and single local physical-plan identity were checked. Existing registry versions/checksums unchanged.
vendor_review.unit_tests: Default-members deliberately remain9 Comet packages. Explicit vendor test target is required. Current commands select core and vendor together for Comet feature unification; statistics test_utils run is additional, never --all-features (force_hash_collisions).
vendor_review.formatting: Vendor-local rustfmt.toml from DataFusion55.2.0 (edition2024,width90); do not reformat published Rust sources using Comet edition2021,width100.
vendor_review.clippy: Strict Comet workspace clippy PASSED with vendor excluded/no-deps; pristine vendor deprecated warning retained and documented.
vendor_review.compiler_versions: Upstream CI uses stable; draft release builder now pins1.100.0 to host. Compiler parity must be verified including lint jobs. Old Joom pin was1.99.0.

release_review.contract: BaseJAR1.2.0 names/contents; publication GAV version equals immutable joom-1.2-* tag. No publish authorized. --validate-only must complete before credentials, staging or HTTP.
release_review.tag_validation: Use refs/tags/<version>^{commit}, not arbitrary Git ref; compare tag commit with commit.txt, lock SHA and artifact hashes.
release_review.packaging: Preserve Linux arm64/aarch64 and amd64/x86-64-v3, GLIBC<=2.31, exactly two libcomet.so entries, no libcomet.dylib, byte-compare libraries and verify all3 Delta SPI resources.
release_review.stale_resource: Host Mac dylib is staged under spark/target/classes/org/apache/comet/darwin/aarch64. Removing only old JAR is insufficient. Draft cleans only generated native resources; final archive validation must reject stale macOS libraries.
release_review.do_not_root_clean: Root Maven clean would delete target/joom-spark-4.2.1 fixture and release outputs under target. Preserve them.
release_review.provenance: Before/after builds verify clean tracked+untracked source tree, stable HEAD and root Cargo.lock. Cache Cargo registry and git sources (pinned Iceberg git dependency). Record actual compiler/images/flags/versions/hashes.
release_review.qualification: uname/container execution probes are not native/JAR execution proof, especially amd64 x86-64-v3 under emulation. Both packaged architectures require real smoke tests. JFrog no-overwrite concurrency depends on server policy and is not established by local dry-run.
release_review.remaining_runtime_qualification: AMD64 runtime qualification incomplete under Rosetta; native runner unavailable. Real GCP/production performance and later groups remain.

performance: Use existing project benchmarks only, no special performance framework; no performance or production GCP qualification has been claimed.
pause: G01 implementation/build and ARM64 smoke passed; AMD64 runtime verification incomplete under Rosetta/FORK. User requested report with limitation. Review/confirmation before integration; G02 not authorized.

sparksql_resolution.repository_config: Task-local SBT config uses Maven Local first then approved Central; no new source checkout or cache relocation.
sparksql_resolution.artifact_identity: Compare selected sql/Test/dependencyClasspath and fullClasspath Comet JAR SHA to installed-fork-identity.json; sameGAV upstreamexists.
sparksql_resolution.from_url_warning: SBT ModuleID.from URL is fallback only; do not rely on it to force fork if artifact is published upstream.
sparksql_resolution.cache_repairs: Fetched exact missing Parquet1.17.0 tests classifiers, Log4j api/core2.25.3, util-interface1.11.5 via ordinary Maven. Only incomplete task-created SBT1.12.8 boot reset; shared/unrelated caches preserved.
